name: manzanilla_publish_interpretation_v2
description: Publish one complete interpretation caption AFTER emitting the spoken translation. Display only; never block or precede speech. Do not speak again in this turn after this call. For unclear source language, report silently with an empty translation. Never call for your own greeting, output or background audio.

arguments.name: source_language
arguments.description: The language of this human utterance: exactly the selected guest code, selected receptionist code, or und if unclear. Identify from this utterance; never alternate or infer from turn order. Use und for ambiguous names, numbers and words shared by both languages.

arguments.name: original
arguments.description: The complete original human utterance exactly as transcribed. Preserve all words, punctuation, names and numbers. One record per utterance; repetitions are separate calls.

arguments.name: translation
arguments.description: The complete faithful translation into the OTHER selected language, identical to the translation just emitted as speech. Do not speak it again. Empty string when source_language is und; do not invent a direction.
